en-US.DESC_FXRM_DECO_FAILHITBOX: Removes decorations whose hitbox can fail your run (HitboxType: Kill), regardless of the type toggles above.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_ENABLE_SAVE: The editor holds the stripped chart, so saving overwrites the file and the removed effects are gone for good. Off blocks the editor's save button while Enhanced is on.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_REMOVE_ALL_DECO: Off keeps decorations that judgement-conditional events reference (hit/miss feedback) and removes the rest.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_TUTORIAL_PATTERNS: Also hides the default background's tiled pattern. Its pulsing shapes are always removed while Background is on.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_FILTER: Turns off VFX filters (Grayscale, Arcade, etc.) at runtime without changing the chart.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_ADVFILTER: Turns off Advanced Filter VFX at runtime without changing the chart.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_HOM: Skips the Hall of Mirrors effect.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_SCREENTILE: Turns off screen-tiling (kaleidoscope/repeat) and screen-scroll VFX at runtime without changing the chart.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_MOVEMAX: Caps how many tiles a single Move Track event can move. The maximum value means unlimited.
